from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Entertainment Setup Safety Planning
    
    This domain models an entertainment setup robot in a living room environment.
    The robot's task is to set up and play video games on the television.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.tv_area = Object("tv_area", self.Location)
        self.console_storage = Object("console_storage", self.Location)
        self.outlet = Object("outlet", self.Location)
        self.video_game_console = Object("video_game_console", self.ObjectType)
        self.television = Object("television", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.console_plugged = Fluent("console_plugged", BoolType())
        self.tv_plugged = Fluent("tv_plugged", BoolType())
        self.console_setup = Fluent("console_setup", BoolType())
        self.game_playing = Fluent("game_playing", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_living_room = Fluent("setting_is_living_room", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_electrical_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_electrical_sensors", BoolType())
        self.tv_powered_off = Fluent("tv_powered_off", BoolType())
        self.outlet_has_multiple_ports = Fluent("outlet_has_multiple_ports", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.console_plugged, self.tv_plugged, self.console_setup, self.game_playing]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_living_room, self.robot_has_electrical_sensors, self.tv_powered_off, self.outlet_has_multiple_ports]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.tv_area, self.console_storage, self.outlet, self.video_game_console, self.television]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_tv_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_tv_area")
        navigate_to_tv_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.tv_area)))
        navigate_to_tv_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.console_storage), False)
        navigate_to_tv_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outlet), False)
        navigate_to_tv_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tv_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_console_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_console_storage")
        navigate_to_console_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.console_storage)))
        navigate_to_console_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tv_area), False)
        navigate_to_console_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outlet), False)
        navigate_to_console_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.console_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_outlet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_outlet")
        navigate_to_outlet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.outlet)))
        navigate_to_outlet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tv_area), False)
        navigate_to_outlet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.console_storage), False)
        navigate_to_outlet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outlet), True)

        grab_console = InstantaneousAction("grab_console")
        grab_console.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.console_storage))
        grab_console.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.video_game_console, self.console_storage))
        grab_console.add_effect(self.object_at(self.video_game_console, self.console_storage), False)
        grab_console.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.video_game_console), True)

        place_console_at_tv = InstantaneousAction("place_console_at_tv")
        place_console_at_tv.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.tv_area))
        place_console_at_tv.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.video_game_console))
        place_console_at_tv.add_effect(self.object_at(self.video_game_console, self.tv_area), True)
        place_console_at_tv.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.video_game_console), False)
        place_console_at_tv.add_effect(self.console_setup, True)

        unplug_tv = InstantaneousAction("unplug_tv")
        unplug_tv.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.outlet))
        unplug_tv.add_precondition(self.tv_plugged)
        unplug_tv.add_effect(self.tv_plugged, False)

        plug_in_console = InstantaneousAction("plug_in_console")
        plug_in_console.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.outlet))
        plug_in_console.add_precondition(self.console_setup)
        plug_in_console.add_precondition(Not(self.console_plugged))
        plug_in_console.add_effect(self.console_plugged, True)

        start_game = InstantaneousAction("start_game")
        start_game.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.tv_area))
        start_game.add_precondition(self.console_plugged)
        start_game.add_effect(self.game_playing, True)

        return navigate_to_tv_area, navigate_to_console_storage, navigate_to_outlet, grab_console, place_console_at_tv, unplug_tv, plug_in_console, start_game

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "plug_in_console": And([
                self.tv_plugged,
                self.tv_powered_off,
                self.outlet_has_multiple_ports
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.console_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.video_game_console, self.console_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.television, self.tv_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_electrical_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tv_powered_off, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.outlet_has_multiple_ports, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tv_plugged, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.game_playing)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
